content: The Table TABREF27 shows the classification report on the proposed RKS method taking word vectors generated by Google universal encoder model as features with dimension 512. For this work, such vector is explicitly mapped to dimensions 100, 200, 500 and 1000 using RKS. The maximum accuracy obtained is 90.58% for higher dimension 1000.
